stem: Which argument might opponents of the New Deal have used in their response to this theater production?

options.label: A
options.text: It exposed citizens in rural areas to quality artistic expression.

options.label: B
options.text: It demonstrated wasteful and unnecessary government spending.

options.label: C
options.text: It provided artists with opportunities to work and entertain the public.

options.label: D
options.text: It failed to adequately educate citizens on the structure of government.
